changes: Added a boarded-player relation test using the existing D2 ship controller snapshot application path, not a direct transform write to the player.
Applied ten changing ship position/heading/speed samples and checked that the player stayed under the stable ship root with the same local deck position and local rotation.
Restored the original sailing snapshot and verified the normal safe disembark path still returned to Character mode.

remaining_scope: The snapshot route proves deck following, not native Player W/S/A/D input or final visual camera quality; Q13 and Q31 remain separate.
Q11 must cover safe disembark at the authored shore/ramp, moving/remote/no-ground refusal and ten complete legal/illegal cycles.
This card does not validate ship collision or open-sea navigation correctness beyond the existing D2 snapshot owner path.
status_boundary: Q10 VERIFIED means a boarded player remains stable relative to the stable gameplay ship root while that root translates and rotates through the D2 sailing snapshot path. It does not claim full sailing, input or visual acceptance.
